top_reviews.title: Best shoes ever
top_reviews.text: I live in these shoes.  They are so comfortable.  I wore out a pair and before I could replace them, my plantar fasciitis flared up, reminding me that it was for more than just comfort that I got these shoes.  Once I got another pair, the plantar fasciitits disappeared again.

top_reviews.title: Too small but nice looking shoe
top_reviews.text:
I ordered two pair of size 12 shoes, a pair of Rockport and these Finn Comfort Torrance.

The Rockport fit perfectly, but the Finn Comfort are too small. Comparing the length of the shoes, I saw that the Finn Comfort were just over a half inch shorter than the Rockport.

I guess the European sizes don't translate well: Amazon said they were 11.5 European size but 12 US size, but the Finn Comfort were clearly not US size 12.

However, they look very nice, well made, and the inside pads were comfortable, they seemed to be made from cork.

I re-ordered to US size 12.5, and I hope that clears the size issue. But my warning to you, if you are interested order a size up. Don't listen to the Amazon label that says they are sized appropriately.
